subjects.description: An older mechanic standing at the engine bay, with oil-dark hands and a squared stance.
A younger mechanic with rolled sleeves and grease on his hands, facing the older man.
A garage engine on a stand with an exposed belt and cooling metal.

claims.text: Two mechanics argue over an engine in a cramped garage.
The garage is lit by one hanging work lamp and crowded with oil-dark tools on a bench.
The older mechanic sets a wrench on the fender and straightens from the open engine bay.
The younger mechanic wipes grease from his hands with a rag and gestures at a belt on the engine block.
The engine ticks as it cools, and the men stand close in a narrow aisle with metal shelves pressing in.
